notes.title: A Special Place In Hell is going Free to Play!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

A Special Place In Hell is going free to play as of Saturday June 17th 2023. This means the game will be replaced by a free version that lacks hosting capabilities.

In order to host games, players will need to purchase the "full version" DLC for 5 USD on steam. For those who have already purchased the game, contact us on steam or by email at aspihdev@gmail.com with proof of purchase or ownership to receive free steam keys for the full version DLC.

Furthermore, there is a planned release for the game on Itch.io for both the free and full version of the game, which should be cross-compatible with the steam versions.

A HUGE thanks to those of you who purchased, played and supported this game during it's paid era.

Looking forward to seeing new faces in the game.

-ASPIH dev
